transcript.content: Hello, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I don’t think people are being honest about what happened around my father’s death. Everyone keeps telling me the hospital records and the donation emails all line up, but when I look at the timestamps and the missing attachments, and then certain people in the community avoid my questions… it just seems obvious to me that someone is hiding something.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve been stressed and I’ve gone over things in my head a lot, but I’m not hearing voices when I’m alone.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say depressed most of the day nearly every day. I’ve been upset and preoccupied, but I’m not sure that’s the same thing.
Did these concerns start after your father died?
Yes. It started in the period after he died, when I was going through his records and messages. It’s been about nine months now.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
No, not really. I haven’t had a stretch where I felt unusually energized or like I didn’t need sleep.
Do you believe for certain that people are hiding the truth about your father’s death?

Yes. I know people keep saying the records and the donation emails all match up, but when I look at the timestamps and the missing attachments, and then certain people in the community avoid answering me… it feels obvious that someone is hiding what really happened with my father’s death.
Aside from what you believe about your father’s death, have you had any other beliefs that other people say are definitely not true?

No, not really. It’s mostly this one thing about my father’s death. People tell me I’m reading too much into the hospital records and donation emails, but when I compare the timestamps, the missing attachments, and how some community members dodge my questions, it seems obvious to me that someone is hiding what really happened.
Since these concerns began, has your ability to work or manage your usual daily life clearly gotten worse?

Not clearly, no. I still go to work, handle my projects, pay my bills, and keep my normal routine. The main problem is when I bring up my questions about my father’s records with family or people in the community—that’s when things get tense.
Have you had times when you felt that ordinary things around you—like TV, radio, social media posts, or strangers’ comments—were actually sending messages meant specifically for you?
No, I don’t think so. I use social media and see the news like anyone else, but I haven’t felt like posts or TV or strangers were sending messages specifically to me.
Have you become much less emotionally expressive than you used to be?
I don’t think so. I mean, I still react to things, still joke around at work sometimes. Maybe I’ve been more preoccupied, but I haven’t noticed being flat or anything like that.
Has anyone actually harmed, poisoned, or otherwise interfered with you because of what you believe about your father’s death?

No, not directly. I haven’t been poisoned or physically harmed or anything like that. It’s more that I’m convinced someone is hiding what really happened with my father’s death. The records, the donation emails, the timestamps, missing attachments… and then certain people avoid my questions. That’s the part that doesn’t add up to me.
Was your father’s death itself the main stressful event that these concerns began in response to?
Yes, I’d say it started after my father died. Not exactly the day of, but in the period after, when I was going through his records and messages. It’s been about nine months now.
Since your father died, have you been persistently yearning or longing for him?

I mean, I miss him, yes. But I’m not sure I’d call it constant yearning. It comes up at certain times, like when something reminds me of him, but it’s not like I’m spending every day just longing for him.
Have you ever seen things that other people could not see?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see.
Because of these concerns about your father’s death, have you been feeling so distressed that it has clearly disrupted your life?

Not clearly, no. I still go to work, keep up with my projects, pay my bills, and stick to my usual routine. It gets tense mostly when I bring up my questions about my father’s records with family or people in the community. That’s where it causes problems.
Have you had a period of at least one month when you felt your thoughts were being controlled by someone else?

No, I wouldn’t say my thoughts are being controlled by someone else. It’s more that I can’t ignore what I’m seeing. People keep saying the hospital records and donation emails all line up, but when I compare the timestamps, the missing attachments, and how certain community members avoid my questions, it seems obvious to me that someone is hiding what really happened around my father’s death.
Has anyone you trust been able to convince you that you might be mistaken about people hiding the truth about your father’s death?

No. People I trust have tried, sure. They tell me the records and the donation emails all match up, but when I look at the timestamps, the missing attachments, and how some community members avoid answering questions, I just don’t buy it. It still seems obvious to me that someone is hiding what really happened with my father’s death.
Have you had the experience of hearing your thoughts spoken out loud, as if someone else could hear them?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve never had my thoughts feel like they were being spoken out loud or like other people could hear them.
Before your father died, had you ever strongly believed that someone was conspiring against you?
No, not before then. This really started after my father died, when I was going through his records and messages. It’s been going on about nine months now.
Has anyone outside your family, after reviewing the records and emails, agreed that there is real evidence your father’s death was being covered up?

Not really in an official way, no. People outside my family keep saying the hospital records and the donation emails line up. But when I compare the timestamps, the missing attachments, and how certain people in the community avoid answering me directly, it still looks obvious to me that someone is hiding what really happened with my father’s death.
